result.title: Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
result.summary: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.

AI.brief_summary: 构建带标注的自我中心网球视频数据集（同步五个外部视角、全局位置、触球时刻与击球类型），比较图像编码器、视频编码器与 VLM 加预测头在七项时空预测任务（2D/3D 定位、未来轨迹、正反手预测、下一次触球时间与触点 3D 位置）上的表现，并用条件扩散模型从视觉预测实时生成全身网球动作。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文报告更长历史不改善球轨迹预测、模型更依赖场景上下文而非帧间运动，且深度信息对 3D 定位关键，为「内部状态保留哪些视觉信息」提供直接诊断；「下一次触球时间」预测也近似于时序上的停止决策，但其未涉及 latent 推理生成或答案使用，联系偏外围，可供核查表示与 STOP 时机的评估方式。
